visualBrief: The 803 m Southern Bridge has six orange saddle pylons with eight pairs of stays apiece, twin steel box girders, six traffic lanes and two sidewalks. Board-formed concrete piers rise from the Daugava beneath the orange steelwork.
observations: The orange pylon tapers to its deck attachment and widens into a rounded cable saddle. The red-orange twin boxes and board-formed piers are visible from the river.
Six traffic lanes are separated by guardrails and a single central line of stays. The outer walkways use vertical bars and bent steel streetlights.
limitations: The mapped carriageways, sidewalks, bearings and exterior proportions set the placement. The vertical road profile, footing depths and small fittings are visualization estimates from the exterior photos and the viewer terrain.
The 803 m crossing is authored. The nearby elevated continuation and interchange use the viewer’s mapped road geometry.
